material_decisions.decision: Rigorous default changes agent behavior by forcing explicit planning gates, test-led logic changes, DB-only analysis, fail-fast contracts, no hidden fallback, no dual paths, and issue-backed compromises.
Accepted cost is slower iteration, more local verification, more documentation upkeep, fewer compatibility shortcuts, and more issue creation for deferred compromises.
Docs-only edits, exploratory notebooks/prototypes, and isolated scratch outputs may be pragmatic, but promotion requires tests, metrics, or docs.
DB/ingestion, evo/probability, latent_power/compound_prior contracts, physics/preprocessing, and committed report schemas require subsystem-specific evidence.
Correct agent behavior is proven by focused test commands, calibration/backtest metrics, schema/consumer checks, validation queries, L1-L4 physics evidence, or captured gate evidence.

Commit sensitivity is resolved: local commits allowed after verification; push/open PR require explicit user ask unless publishing was requested; merge requires ask; force-push to main/master forbidden.

contradictions_or_gaps.gap: The checklist engine exists in Constellation skill directories, not at repo-local scripts/checklist_engine.py as referenced by the Workbench docs.
The live work record needed to be converted to a full engine-valid checklist.
